school: 数学（以天元术把中国代数学推向方程化轨道的宋元数学四大家之一）
historical_significance: 李冶（1192-1279），本名李治，字仁卿，号敬斋，真定栾城人，金末元初数学家、文学家，宋元数学四大家（与秦九韶、杨辉、朱世杰）之一。金正大七年（1230）词赋科进士，权钧州知州；1232 年蒙古破钧州后微服北渡弃官，流离山西十六年，于桐川著成《测圆海镜》十二卷（1248）——以'立天元一'的记号化方程方法系统处理直角三角形内切圆与旁切圆 170 问，是中国现存最早的系统天元术著作，卷首'识别杂记'692 条公式构成全书关系总表；1251 年起讲学于元氏封龙山，'从学者甚众'，与元好问并称'元李'；1259 年成《益古演段》三卷，把天元术逐段翻译为可验证的条段法，为深法配浅写的教本典范；两度应忽必烈之召（1257 问策、1265 翰林学士），献'天下未尝乏材''立法度正纲纪'之议而月余即辞官。临终嘱子'著述尽可燔去，独《测圆海镜》不可以'，清儒再发现后被誉为'中土数学之宝书'（阮元）；另有《敬斋古今黈》等文史杂考传世。
historical_significance_en: Li Ye (1192-1279), originally named Li Zhi, courtesy name Renqing, sobriquet Jingzhai, a native of Luancheng in Zhending, mathematician and man of letters at the Jin-Yuan transition, one of the Four Great Mathematicians of the Song-Yuan era (with Qin Jiushao, Yang Hui and Zhu Shijie). Jinshi of the cifu track in 1230 and acting governor of Junzhou; after the Mongol capture of the city in 1232 he crossed the Yellow River in disguise and abandoned office, wandering Shanxi for sixteen years and completing the Ceyuan Haijing (Sea Mirror of Circle Measurements) in twelve juans at Tongchuan in 1248 — 170 problems on inscribed and escribed circles of the right triangle handled by the notational equation method of 'establishing the celestial element one', the earliest extant systematic tianyuan shu treatise in China, its opening 'recognition register' of 692 formulas forming the book's master table of relations; from 1251 he taught at Fenglong Mountain, 'learners coming in crowds', paired with Yuan Haowen as the 'Yuan-Li'; in 1259 the Yigu Yanduan in three juans translated tianyuan shu segment by segment into verifiable diagram-steps, the exemplar of pairing a deep method with a plain primer; twice summoned by Kublai Khan (counseled in 1257, Hanlin academician in 1265), he offered 'the world has never lacked talent' and 'establish laws and standards' yet resigned within a month. Dying, he told his son all his writings might be burned 'only the Ceyuan Haijing must not'; rediscovered by Qing scholars, Ruan Yuan hailed it as 'the treasure-book of Chinese mathematics'; the Jingzhai Gujin Tu miscellanies also survive.
unique_thinking: 李冶思维模式的独特性在于'方程化+可教化+存续设计'三位一体：他不只发明了记号化方程（天元术），还同时解决了方法的三个周边问题——(1)知识形态：以'立天元一'把应用几何问题全部化归为一元方程，使求解从灵感依赖变为算法依赖，卷首'识别杂记'692 条把全部关系前置成可检索总表，体系获得可拆卸的自明性；(2)知识传播：深轨《测圆海镜》与浅轨《益古演段》双轨成书，深法逐段翻译为可手工验证的条段——为同一体系同时保证极限与存续；(3)知识存续：乱世十六年流离著述、临终'独此一册不可燔'的孤本裁决、封龙山聚徒的学脉设计——把'学问如何活过王朝更替'当作方法论问题本身来解。他两次应召献策而月余辞官，示范了学者与权力的'顾问性在场+退出权'接口；其'名词代词之辨'的考据精确性则为整个体系提供了语言地基。
unique_thinking_en: The uniqueness of Li Ye's thinking is a triad of equational form, teachability and survival design: he not only invented notational equations (tianyuan shu) but simultaneously solved three adjacent problems of method. (1) Form of knowledge: 'establish the celestial element' reduced all applied geometry to one-variable equations, turning solution from inspiration-dependence to algorithm-dependence, while the opening 'recognition register' of 692 formulas front-loaded every relation into a retrievable master table, giving the system disassemblable self-evidence. (2) Spread of knowledge: twin-track books — the deep Ceyuan Haijing and the plain Yigu Yanduan — translated the deep method segment by segment into hand-verifiable steps, securing at once the system's ceiling and its survival. (3) Survival of knowledge: sixteen years of exiled writing, the deathbed decree that only this one book must not burn, and the academy at Fenglong Mountain as a lineage design — treating 'how learning outlives dynasties' as a methodological problem in itself. Twice summoned to counsel yet resigning within a month, he modeled the scholar-power interface of advisory presence plus right of withdrawal; his philological precision — 'the named versus the pronominal' — laid the linguistic foundation of the whole system.
civilization_zh: 金末元初的北方：生于金中都大兴府（1192），童年随父宦游，青年即以文名重中原；1230 年进士出仕金朝；1232 年钧州陷落北渡流亡，金亡（1234）后绝意仕进，隐居忻崞、桐川治学；1248 年《测圆海镜》成书于桐川；1251 年移居封龙山讲学，与元好问往来唱和；1257 年忽必烈藩邸召问；1259 年《益古演段》成书；1260 年后元廷屡召，1265 年就翰林学士月余即辞；晚居元氏，1279 年卒——其一生横跨金、蒙古、元三政权而学术不辍
civilization_en: The north at the Jin-Yuan transition: born in the Jin capital (1192), traveling with his father's postings as a child and famous for letters in youth; jinshi and Jin official in 1230; after Junzhou fell in 1232 he crossed north into exile, and with Jin's fall in 1234 gave up all thought of office, studying in the忻-Ling region and at Tongchuan; the Ceyuan Haijing finished there in 1248; from 1251 teaching at Fenglong Mountain and exchanging poems with Yuan Haowen; summoned to Kublai's princely court in 1257; the Yigu Yanduan finished in 1259; after 1260 repeated Yuan summons, the Hanlin post taken and quit within a month in 1265; he settled at Yuanshi and died in 1279 — one life spanning Jin, Mongol and Yuan regimes without interruption of scholarship

cross_references.description_zh: 李冶与秦九韶同代而南北分治（金元/南宋），同把中国代数推向方程化：秦九韶《数书九章》以正负开方术解高次方程数值根，李冶《测圆海镜》以天元术建立方程——一个精于'解'，一个精于'立'；两人互不知晓而方法互补，恰是宋元数学高峰的一体两面；清代焦循、李锐同时校释二人著作，才把'立'与'解'重新接通。
cross_references.description_en: Contemporaries ruling under rival regimes (Jin-Yuan north, Southern Song south), Li Ye and Qin Jiushao both drove Chinese algebra toward the equational: Qin's Shushu Jiuzhang solved high-degree equations numerically by the positive-negative root method, Li's Ceyuan Haijing established equations by tianyuan shu — one mastered 'solving', the other 'forming'; unknowing of each other yet complementary, two faces of the Song-Yuan mathematical summit; Qing scholars Jiao Xun and Li Rui annotated both, finally reconnecting forming and solving.

cross_references.description_zh: 李冶与朱世杰相隔约半个世纪而同属北方天元术传统：朱世杰《四元玉鉴》把李冶的一元天元推广为四元（天地人物），《算学启蒙》作为其入门教本复制了李冶'深书配浅书'的双轨模式；李冶封龙山讲学所维系的北方数学学脉，正是朱世杰'燕山数学'得以站立的肩膀——从一元到四元的阶梯由李冶奠基。
cross_references.description_en: Half a century apart yet of one northern tianyuan tradition: Zhu Shijie's Siyuan Yujian extended Li Ye's single-element method to four elements (heaven, earth, man, thing), and his Suanxue Qimeng primer replicated Li's twin-track model of deep book plus plain book; the northern mathematical lineage sustained by Li's Fenglong Mountain teaching is the shoulder on which Zhu's 'Yanshan mathematics' stood — the ladder from one element to four was built on Li's foundation.

cross_references.description_zh: 李冶与笛卡尔相隔近四百年而共享'设元-列方程-求解'的分析法骨架：天元术的'立天元一'与解析几何的'设坐标变量'同为未知量显式化；不同处在配套工程——笛卡尔以坐标系把代数与几何双向打通，李冶以'识别杂记'总表与《益古演段》浅写轨把方法与传承打通——两人分别补全了方程思维的不同周边。
cross_references.description_en: Nearly four centuries apart, Li Ye and Descartes share the analytic skeleton of set-the-unknown, form-the-equation, solve: tianyuan's 'establish the celestial element' and analytic geometry's coordinate variables are the same explicitation of the unknown; the difference lies in the surrounding works — Descartes joined algebra and geometry two-way with coordinates, Li joined method and transmission with the recognition register and the Yigu Yanduan plain track — each completing a different flank of equation-thinking.

cross_references.description_zh: 李冶与蒋守敬（郭守敬）同在元初为历算之学分流：郭守敬以《授时历》把数学投向天文工程（国家项目），李冶以《测圆海镜》把数学保存在个人著作与书院（文明项目）；王恂、郭守敬历法工作背后即有天元术一系的方法储备——两条路线共同证明：乱世之后数学的存续既需要国家工程，也需要'孤本守心'的民间学脉。
cross_references.description_en: Li Ye and Guo Shoujing, contemporaries of early Yuan, split the mathematical vocation: Guo's Shoushi Calendar threw mathematics into astronomical engineering (a state project), Li's Ceyuan Haijing kept it alive in private books and the academy (a civilizational project); the calendar work of Wang Xun and Guo Shoujing drew on method reserves of the tianyuan line — two routes jointly proving that after dynastic ruin, mathematics survives both through state engineering and through the private lineage of 'safeguarding the masterwork'.

modes.name_en: The Method of Establishing the Unknown Element
modes.domain_zh: 把一切应用问题化归为代数方程：'立天元一'——先显式设出未知量，让所有已知关系围绕它重写为等式，再机械地化简求解——未知量的显式命名是方程思维的第一步
modes.domain_en: Reduce every applied problem to an algebraic equation: 'establish the one celestial element' — first name the unknown explicitly, rewrite all known relations as equations around it, then reduce mechanically to solution — the explicit naming of the unknown is the first act of equation-thinking
modes.definition_zh: 把一切应用问题化归为代数方程：'立天元一'——先显式设出未知量，让所有已知关系围绕它重写为等式，再机械地化简求解——未知量的显式命名是方程思维的第一步
modes.definition_en: Reduce every applied problem to an algebraic equation: 'establish the one celestial element' — first name the unknown explicitly, rewrite all known relations as equations around it, then reduce mechanically to solution — the explicit naming of the unknown is the first act of equation-thinking
modes.key_quote_en: 'Establish the celestial element one as such-and-such.'
process_zh: 先把问题翻译为'求什么'：明确目标量并给它一个符号（天元）——问题从叙述变为方程之前，必须先有一个被命名的未知
围绕未知重写已知：把题设中的每条几何或数量关系改写为含天元的多项式等式——已知不再孤立，而是未知周围的约束网
机械化简：移项、合并、去同类项按固定程序执行——求解不再依赖灵感，而依赖可复演的算法步骤
验证与回代：所得根回代原关系检验——方程的答案是假设，回代才是裁决
process_en: Name what is sought first: give the target quantity a symbol (the celestial element) — before a problem becomes an equation it must have a named unknown

Rewrite the known around the unknown: every given geometric or quantitative relation becomes a polynomial equation containing the element — givens stop being isolated facts and become a constraint web
Reduce mechanically: transposition, merging, cancellation by fixed procedure — solution depends not on inspiration but on reproducible algorithmic steps
Verify by substitution: the root returns to the original relations for checking — an equation's answer is a hypothesis; substitution is the verdict
representative_cases_zh: 《测圆海镜》170 题几乎每题皆以'立天元一为××'开篇：勾股容圆各关系全部化为一元方程求解——中国现存最早的系统性方程著作
《益古演段》64 题：同一方法在方田、动田等更浅问题上的重演——方程法作为通用引擎而非专题技巧
由'洞渊九容'旧法到天元术的跃迁：李冶把只能解特殊构型的几何公式改造为设元列方程的一般程序——从公式记忆到方程生成的范式转换
representative_cases_en: All 170 problems of the Ceyuan Haijing open with 'establish the celestial element as ××': every right-triangle-circle relation reduced to a one-variable equation — the earliest surviving systematic equation treatise in China
The 64 problems of the Yigu Yanduan: the same method replayed on shallower field-measurement problems — the equation as a general engine, not a topic-specific trick

The leap from the old 'Dongyuan nine capacities' formulas to tianyuan shu: Li Ye turned geometric formulas for special configurations into a general set-the-variable-and-form-the-equation procedure — from memorizing formulas to generating equations
modern_applications_zh: 符号代数与方程建模：从韦达到现代'设 x'——未知量显式化仍是解应用题的第一课
机器学习中的目标函数定义：先把'要优化什么'写成显式函数，再谈求解——'立元'的现代工程版
物理建模与量纲分析：把系统写成含未知量的方程组再化简——从现象到方程的同一化归路径
modern_applications_en: Symbolic algebra and equation modeling: from Viète to the modern 'let x be' — naming the unknown remains lesson one of applied problem solving

Objective-function definition in machine learning: write what is to be optimized as an explicit function before solving — the engineering form of 'establishing the element','Physical modeling and dimensional analysis: writing the system as equations with unknowns and reducing — the same path from phenomenon to equation
representative_figures: 李冶（核心）
秦九韶（平行：同代南方，正负开方术与《数书九章》——高次方程数值解的另一支柱）
朱世杰（传承：四元术把一元天元推广至四元——天元术的直接后裔）
韦达（跨文明平行：符号代数使未知量获得系统记号——与天元术相隔三百年的同一洞见）

modes.name_en: The Method of Segment-by-Segment Plain Exposition
modes.domain_zh: 深法必须配浅写：《益古演段》把天元术的抽象程序逐段翻译为'条段'——可手工验证的图解与算例——让不识深法的人也能逐段抵达同一结论；可验证性优先于优雅
modes.domain_en: Deep methods need plain rewritings: the Yigu Yanduan translates tianyuan shu's abstract procedure segment by segment into 'tiao duan' — hand-verifiable diagrams and worked cases — so those who cannot read the deep method reach the same conclusions stepwise; verifiability outranks elegance
modes.definition_zh: 深法必须配浅写：《益古演段》把天元术的抽象程序逐段翻译为'条段'——可手工验证的图解与算例——让不识深法的人也能逐段抵达同一结论；可验证性优先于优雅
modes.definition_en: Deep methods need plain rewritings: the Yigu Yanduan translates tianyuan shu's abstract procedure segment by segment into 'tiao duan' — hand-verifiable diagrams and worked cases — so those who cannot read the deep method reach the same conclusions stepwise; verifiability outranks elegance
modes.key_quote_zh: 演段者，所以明算之条段也
modes.key_quote_en: 'To expand the segments is to lay bare the orderly segments of computation.'
process_zh: 承认理解鸿沟：先接受'懂深法的人'与'需用结论的人'是两个人群——转译不是降低学术，而是扩张学术的到达半径
逐段拆解：把深法的每一步翻译为可独立验证的图解、算术或图形条段——每一段单独可错、可查、可改
配以算例：每法附具体数字演算——抽象程序在具体数字上落地，学习者沿算例重走证明路
保持双向对照：浅写不替代深法，而是与深法并置互注——读者从浅入深有梯，从深入浅有桥
process_en: Accept the comprehension gap: those who command the deep method and those who need its conclusions are two populations — translation is not dumbing down but widening reach
Dismantle segment by segment: translate each step of the deep method into a separately verifiable diagram, arithmetic, or figure — each segment individually checkable, correctable, testable
Attach worked examples: every method gets concrete numerical runs — abstract procedure lands on actual digits, learners re-walk the proof through the example
Keep both levels side by side: the plain version does not replace the deep one; they stand as mutual commentary — an upward ladder and a downward bridge
representative_cases_zh: 《益古演段》64 题每题'法'与'依条段求之'并列：同一问题给出天元术解法与条段图解两条路径——深浅双轨的教科书原型
李冶为'洞渊九容'等前人深法补条段解释：把失传理解的旧术重新接入可教体系
《测圆海镜》卷首'识别杂记'作为全书概念的预备解释——深书内部的浅写缓冲层
representative_cases_en: Each of the 64 Yigu Yanduan problems pairs the method with 'seek it by the segments': the tianyuan solution and a diagrammatic solution given side by side — the prototype of the two-track textbook
Li Ye's segment explanations for earlier deep methods like the 'nine capacities': reconnecting old techniques whose understanding had decayed to a teachable system
The 'recognition notes' at the head of the Ceyuan Haijing as a preparatory plain layer inside the deep book itself
modern_applications_zh: 分层教材与脚手架教学（scaffolding）：同一概念给证明版与直观版——深法浅写的教学工程化
技术文档的'教程/参考'双轨制：Tutorial 与 Reference 并置互注——Django、Rust 等现代文档体系的同一结构
科普写作与'可证伪的比喻'：把前沿理论译为可核查的类比而不失真——法拉第《蜡烛的故事》的同一传统
modern_applications_en: Scaffolded instruction and dual-level textbooks: every concept in proof version and intuitive version — pedagogical engineering of plain exposition
Tutorial/Reference dual-track documentation: the same structure in modern systems like Django and Rust — side-by-side, mutually annotating
Popular science with falsifiable analogies: translating frontier theory into checkable comparisons without distortion — the tradition of Faraday's 'Chemical History of a Candle'
representative_figures: 李冶（核心）
朱世杰（传承：《算学启蒙》作为《四元玉鉴》的预备浅写——'启蒙'与深书配对）
法拉第（跨文明平行：把实验物理浅写为公开演讲——深法的通俗化担当）
欧几里得（对照：《几何原本》的公理化结构是另一种'可逐段验证'）

modes.name_en: The Method of Scholarship Amid Ruin
modes.domain_zh: 王朝崩解不由学者负责，学问断绝才是学者的失职：李冶在金亡国破、流离失所之际选择'潜心研究学问'——把治学从仕途选项改写为文明存续的独立事业
modes.domain_en: The collapse of dynasties is not the scholar's failing; the break of learning is: amid the fall of Jin, exile and hardship, Li Ye chose to 'devote himself to study' — recasting scholarship from a career option into an independent undertaking for civilizational continuity
modes.definition_zh: 王朝崩解不由学者负责，学问断绝才是学者的失职：李冶在金亡国破、流离失所之际选择'潜心研究学问'——把治学从仕途选项改写为文明存续的独立事业
modes.definition_en: The collapse of dynasties is not the scholar's failing; the break of learning is: amid the fall of Jin, exile and hardship, Li Ye chose to 'devote himself to study' — recasting scholarship from a career option into an independent undertaking for civilizational continuity
modes.source_chapter: 《测圆海镜》序及金元之际行止
modes.key_quote_zh: 老大以来，得洞渊九容之说，日夕玩绎
modes.key_quote_en: 'In my later years I obtained the Dongyuan nine-capacity teachings and played upon them day and night.'
process_zh: 切断仕途默认项：国亡后不做'贰臣'也不做遗民怨士——把个人出路问题与学术使命问题分开结算
在最不安定处选最恒久的对象：时局无常而数学关系永恒——把研究投向不随政权存亡的真理域
以'玩绎'养学：'日夕玩绎'——把研究安放在日常节律中而非事件驱动中，乱世的学术靠节律而非靠安定
著述即抵抗：写成可传之书对抗'学问随人亡'——知识的存续被当作对乱世最有效的回答
process_en: Sever the default of office: after the fall, neither collaborator nor embittered loyalist — settling the personal-livelihood question separately from the scholarly-mission question
Aim at the most durable object amid the most unstable times: regimes perish, mathematical relations do not — research directed at truths that outride dynasties
Feed scholarship with rhythm: 'playing upon it day and night' — research anchored in daily routine, not event-driven; learning in troubled times rides on rhythm, not stability
Writing as resistance: a transmissible book against 'learning dies with the man' — the survival of knowledge as the most effective answer to an age of ruin
representative_cases_zh: 1232-1248 十六年流离中的《测圆海镜》：从钧州陷落到桐川成书——全书在此期间从'洞渊九容'旧说生长为系统天元术
拒绝出仕新朝而聚徒讲学于封龙山：以教学维持学问的社会存在——乱世中学问的'驯化保存'
《敬斋古今黈》横跨文史哲医的杂考：证明治学之心未因国亡而收缩，反而更宽
representative_cases_en: Sixteen years of exile bearing the Ceyuan Haijing (1232-1248): from the fall of Junzhou to completion at Tongchuan — the old 'nine capacities' grew into systematic tianyuan shu in that span
Refusing the new dynasty's office while teaching at Fenglong Mountain: keeping learning socially alive through teaching — the domestic preservation of scholarship in troubled times
The Jingzhai Gujin Tu, miscellanies across literature, history, philosophy and medicine: proof the scholarly mind widened rather than contracted with the dynasty's fall
modern_applications_zh: 战时大学与'知识难民'传统：从抗战西南联大到今日流亡学者网络——乱世守护学问的现代建制
开源社区在商业动荡中的持续维护：项目比公司活得久——把代码存续置于雇佣关系之上
基础科学的'长期主义'资助：承认文明延续依赖不随周期涨落的慢研究
modern_applications_en: Wartime universities and the 'knowledge refugee' tradition: from Lianda in wartime China to today's networks for displaced scholars — the modern institution of guarding learning amid ruin
Open-source maintenance surviving corporate turmoil: projects outliving companies — code's continuity placed above employment
Long-horizon funding for basic science: civilization's continuity depends on slow research that does not sway with cycles
representative_figures: 李冶（核心）
司马迁（平行：'究天人之际'的著述选择——忍辱而成一家之言）
伊本·赫勒敦（跨文明平行：乱世中写《历史绪论》——把废墟变成分析对象）
元好问（同代平行：'元李'并称，以诗存史——文与数两种存续之学）

modes.name_en: The Method of Safeguarding the Masterwork
modes.domain_zh: 在全部著述中辨明哪一部是不可替代的：'死后尽可燔去，独《测圆海镜》不可以'——临终裁决把作品的真正价值排序从谦辞中剥离出来，为后世保存指出唯一焦点
modes.domain_en: Discern which one work is irreplaceable among all: 'after my death the rest may be burned, only the Ceyuan Haijing must not' — the deathbed judgment strips the true ranking of one's works out of conventional modesty, pointing posterity to the single focus worth preserving
modes.definition_zh: 在全部著述中辨明哪一部是不可替代的：'死后尽可燔去，独《测圆海镜》不可以'——临终裁决把作品的真正价值排序从谦辞中剥离出来，为后世保存指出唯一焦点
modes.definition_en: Discern which one work is irreplaceable among all: 'after my death the rest may be burned, only the Ceyuan Haijing must not' — the deathbed judgment strips the true ranking of one's works out of conventional modesty, pointing posterity to the single focus worth preserving
modes.source_chapter: 李冶临终遗嘱（王德渊后序所记）
modes.key_quote_zh: 吾生平著述，死后尽可燔去，独《测圆海镜》一书……后世必有知者
modes.key_quote_en: 'All my writings may be burned after my death — only the Ceyuan Haijing cannot. However small its nines, it holds my deepest thought; there will be knowers in later generations.'
process_zh: 对全部作品做冷酷排序：承认多数著述是'可燔'的——价值判断的诚实先于价值判断的结果
标定不可替代者：判据不是体量与声誉，而是'精思致力'的独特投入——孤独思考的密度决定不可替代性
公开说出排序：不把真相留给猜——遗嘱式的明示防止后世按错误权重保存
预言知者的到来：'后世必有知者'——把作品的最终估值委托给时间而非当代，同时为那一日的到来保留文本
process_en: Rank all works coldly: concede that most writings are 'burnable' — honesty of valuation precedes its outcome
Mark the irreplaceable: the criterion is not bulk or fame but the unique investment of 'deepest thought' — the density of solitary thinking decides irreplaceability
Say the ranking aloud: do not leave the truth to be guessed — testamentary explicitness prevents posterity from preserving by the wrong weights
Prophesy the knowers: 'there will be those who understand in later generations' — entrust the work's final valuation to time rather than to the present, while keeping the text safe for that day
representative_cases_zh: 临终对子李冶明言'独《测圆海镜》不可燔'：全书 170 题的天元术系统因这一裁决而千年可追
《测圆海镜》成书 31 年未获刊刻而作者不动摇：以'后世知者'信念支撑未验证期的坚守
清代阮元'中土数学之宝书'、李善兰'中华算书无有胜于此者'的再发现：五百年后'知者'如期而至
representative_cases_en: The deathbed word to his son — 'only the Ceyuan Haijing may not be burned': the 170-problem system of tianyuan shu traceable across a millennium by that one judgment
Thirty-one years unpublished after completion, the author unmoved: the 'knowers will come' belief sustaining the unvalidated period
The Qing re-discovery — Ruan Yuan's 'treasure-book of Chinese mathematics', Li Shanlan's 'no Chinese mathematical book surpasses it': five centuries on, the knowers arrived on schedule
modern_applications_zh: 开源项目的'核心仓库'意识：维护者明确标出哪个库是毕生所在、值得无条件保全——个人遗产的技术版
科研基金的'长期持有'：对高沉没成本、晚回报研究的持续资助——'后世必有知者'的制度化
个人知识管理的'烧掉测试'：定期自问哪些笔记值得火灾中抢出——价值排序的日常操练
modern_applications_en: The 'core repository' consciousness in open source: maintainers naming which library is their life's work, to be preserved unconditionally — the technical form of a personal legacy
Patient capital for long-payoff research: sustained funding for high-sunk-cost, late-return inquiry — 'knowers will come' institutionalized
The burn test in personal knowledge management: regularly asking which notes one would snatch from a fire — daily practice of value ranking
representative_figures: 李冶（核心）
博尔赫斯（对照：图书馆式的'全存'冲动——与'独此一册'的聚焦裁决构成两极）
卡文迪什（平行：大量未发表手稿——反例：未明示排序导致价值延迟数百年兑现）
司马迁（平行：'藏之名山，传之其人'——同一委托时间的姿态）

modes.name_en: The Method of Counsel on Summons
modes.category: 政治参与/专业知识与权力的接口
modes.domain_zh: 被征召时贡献见识而非交出身份：对忽必烈'立法定制'之问给出'辨奸邪、省刑罚、慎征讨'的专业意见，同时'以老病辞'保住独立——学者对权力的正确姿态是顾问性在场加退出权
modes.domain_en: When summoned, contribute insight without surrendering identity: to Kublai's question on laws and governance he gave professional counsel — 'discern the treacherous, lighten punishments, be cautious in campaigns' — while 'pleading age and illness' to preserve independence; the scholar's right stance to power is advisory presence plus the right to withdraw
modes.definition_zh: 被征召时贡献见识而非交出身份：对忽必烈'立法定制'之问给出'辨奸邪、省刑罚、慎征讨'的专业意见，同时'以老病辞'保住独立——学者对权力的正确姿态是顾问性在场加退出权
modes.definition_en: When summoned, contribute insight without surrendering identity: to Kublai's question on laws and governance he gave professional counsel — 'discern the treacherous, lighten punishments, be cautious in campaigns' — while 'pleading age and illness' to preserve independence; the scholar's right stance to power is advisory presence plus the right to withdraw
modes.key_quote_zh: 天下未尝乏材，求则得之，舍则失之
modes.key_quote_en: 'The world has never lacked talent: seek and you find it; neglect and you lose it.'
process_zh: 应召而不应征：回应权力的求知请求（问学、问策），不交出人身与职业的隶属——见与仕是两个合同
以专业答专业之问：对'治道'的回答落到立法度、正纲纪、省刑罚等可执行项——贡献的是分析而非颂词
设定退出条款：'就职月余，复以老病辞'——用可接受的代价赎回全部时间主权，且不烧断再来进言的通道
把建议写成制度语言：荐贤（'求则得之'）与法度（'立法定制'）都指向可由他人执行的规则——影响力的目标是留下可运转的规范，而非留下自己
process_en: Answer the summons, not the conscription: respond to power's request for knowledge — questions of learning and policy — without surrendering personal or professional allegiance; being consulted and being employed are two separate contracts
Answer professional questions professionally: on 'the way of governance' his reply lands on executable items — law, standards, lighter punishments — analysis, not flattery
Set the exit clause: 'a month in office, then resignation pleading age and illness' — buying back full sovereignty of time at an acceptable price, without burning the channel to counsel again

Write advice as institutional language: the recommendations on talent ('seek and you find') and law point to rules others can execute — the goal of influence is a working norm left behind, not oneself
representative_cases_zh: 1257 年应忽必烈召问'用人治国之道'：提出'天下未尝乏材'与'立法度正纲纪'——被采纳而不因此入幕
1265 年就任翰林学士月余即辞：史载修《实录》等馆阁事务与其学术自尊冲突——用辞职划定参与边界
封龙山讲学期间与各方政权保持均距：金遗民、蒙古藩王、元廷三方的邀请都接其'问'而拒其'命'
representative_cases_en: The 1257 summons by Kublai on selecting men and governing: his 'the world has never lacked talent' and 'establish laws and standards' adopted, without his entering the suite
Resigning the Hanlin academician post a month into 1265: the academicians' compiling of dynastic records clashed with his scholarly self-respect — resignation drew the boundary of participation
At Fenglong Mountain he kept even distance from all regimes: the Jin loyalists, the Mongol prince, the Yuan court — accepting each one's 'questions' while refusing each one's 'commands'
modern_applications_zh: 独立董事与外部顾问制度：现代公司治理把'献言不仕'制度化为任期与薪酬独立——顾问性在场的组织化
技术专家的政策咨询：科学顾问委员会向政府提供证据而不进入党派序列
学界与业界的'半年制'流动：教授企业任职设定期限与回归通道——退出权作为制度设计
modern_applications_en: Independent directors and external advisors: modern governance institutionalizes 'counsel without office' through independent tenure and pay — advisory presence organized
Expert policy consultation: science advisory bodies giving governments evidence while staying outside partisan ranks
Bounded industry secondments for academics: fixed terms and return channels — the right of withdrawal as institutional design
representative_figures: 李冶（核心）
晏婴（源头：'和而不同'的谏议传统）
富兰克林（跨文明平行：出使而不恋栈——把公共贡献与私人身份分开）
许衡（同代对照：同样应忽必烈之召但选择入仕建制——学者对权力的两种接口）

modes.domain_zh: 在体系入口处放一张'识别杂记'：《测圆海镜》卷首以 692 条公式总汇全部'识别'（某量等于某量）——先把系统内的全部关系列成可检索的对照表，再进入推理；元知识前置使体系可被独立核验
modes.domain_en: Place a 'recognition register' at the system's entrance: the Ceyuan Haijing opens with 692 formulas aggregating all 'recognitions' (this quantity equals that) — first list every relation in the system as a retrievable table, then reason; front-loading meta-knowledge makes the system independently checkable
modes.definition_zh: 在体系入口处放一张'识别杂记'：《测圆海镜》卷首以 692 条公式总汇全部'识别'（某量等于某量）——先把系统内的全部关系列成可检索的对照表，再进入推理；元知识前置使体系可被独立核验
modes.definition_en: Place a 'recognition register' at the system's entrance: the Ceyuan Haijing opens with 692 formulas aggregating all 'recognitions' (this quantity equals that) — first list every relation in the system as a retrievable table, then reason; front-loading meta-knowledge makes the system independently checkable
modes.key_quote_zh: 凡大小相形……各以其类会
modes.key_quote_en: 'Great and small set against each other... each gathered with its kind.'
process_zh: 穷举关系清单：把体系内全部'甲等于乙'式的关系逐条列出——不问当下是否用到，先建立全量映射
分类编排：以'大小相形、各以其类会'组织条目——关系按类聚合，检索按类展开
置于推理之前：识别表放在卷首而非附录——读者带着全图进入正文，推理成为对表内关系的引用
让正文可拆验：每题的推导只调用表内公式——任何一步可回溯到总表独立核验，体系获得可拆卸的自明性
process_en: Exhaust the relation list: enumerate every 'A equals B' relation in the system — irrespective of immediate use, first build the complete mapping
Organize by class: 'great and small set against each other, each gathered with its kind' — relations cluster by category, retrieval unfolds by category
Place before the reasoning: the register sits at the head of the book, not the appendix — readers enter the text with the whole map; proofs become citations of table entries

Make the text separately checkable: each problem's derivation only invokes register formulas — every step traceable to the master table for independent verification, giving the system disassemblable self-evidence
representative_cases_zh: 《测圆海镜》'识别杂记'692 条公式覆盖勾股容圆全部关系：后续 170 题实际仅用其中一部分——总表大于用例，为扩展预留接口
各卷解题'草'（细草）与识别表互为注脚：读者可从任一题回查总表、从总表预读全卷
《益古演段》沿用同一结构：条段法解释层与天元术解法层的对照也依赖概念先行的前置说明
representative_cases_en: The 692 formulas of the 'recognition register' covering all circle-in-triangle relations: the 170 later problems use only part — the master table exceeds the use cases, reserving interfaces for extension
Volume-level 'detailed workings' cross-annotating the register: readers enter from any problem back to the table, or pre-read a whole volume from the table
The Yigu Yanduan reusing the same structure: the alignment of segment-method explanations with tianyuan solutions also rests on concept-first front matter
modern_applications_zh: API 文档与类型系统参考：先把全部函数签名与不变式列成总表再读实现——工程版的'识别杂记'
知识图谱与本体工程：先建实体关系全表，再在其上推理与检索
数学物理的'常数表与公式手册'：把领域全部已知关系前置汇编——CRC 手册的传统
modern_applications_en: API references and type-system docs: listing all signatures and invariants before reading implementations — the engineering 'recognition register'
Knowledge graphs and ontology engineering: the full entity-relation table first, reasoning and retrieval on top
Handbooks of constants and formulas in math and physics: the field's known relations pre-compiled — the CRC handbook tradition
representative_figures: 李冶（核心）
欧几里得（对照：《几何原本》从公理出发而非从关系总表出发——两种体系自明性路线）
门捷列夫（平行：元素周期表把全部已知化学关系前置成表——预测空位）
布尔巴基（平行：结构主义把数学按关系结构重组——总表思想的现代形态）

modes.domain_zh: 为同一知识体系同时准备深浅两轨：《测圆海镜》（深法专著）与《益古演段》（浅法教本）相隔十一年先后成书——深轨保证体系的极限，浅轨保证体系的存续与传播
modes.domain_en: Prepare both a deep and a shallow track for one body of knowledge: the Ceyuan Haijing (deep monograph, 1248) and the Yigu Yanduan (plain primer, 1259) written eleven years apart — the deep track secures the system's ceiling, the shallow track secures its survival and spread
modes.definition_zh: 为同一知识体系同时准备深浅两轨：《测圆海镜》（深法专著）与《益古演段》（浅法教本）相隔十一年先后成书——深轨保证体系的极限，浅轨保证体系的存续与传播
modes.definition_en: Prepare both a deep and a shallow track for one body of knowledge: the Ceyuan Haijing (deep monograph, 1248) and the Yigu Yanduan (plain primer, 1259) written eleven years apart — the deep track secures the system's ceiling, the shallow track secures its survival and spread
modes.key_quote_zh: 《益古》演段以喻众，《海镜》细草以藏深
modes.key_quote_en: 'The Yigu expands segments for the many; the Haijing's detailed workings hold the depth.'
process_zh: 先深后浅的成书序：先在专著中把方法推到极限（1248），再回头为大众重写入门（1259）——深度优先，普及随后
识别两轨的读者与判据：深轨以'精思致力'为判据，浅轨以'可逐段验证'为判据——两轨各有其成败标准，不可互为裁判
让两轨互为注脚：浅轨的每一段都能指向深轨的对应处，深轨的概念在浅轨都有落地算例——单向的'简化'升格为双向的'对照'
以浅轨养深轨：教本带来的学习者与讨论是深轨修订的养料——普及不是深度的消耗，而是深度的补给线
process_en: Deep first, then shallow: push the method to its limit in the monograph (1248), then return to rewrite an entry point for the many (1259) — depth first, popularization after

Identify each track's readers and criteria: the deep track judged by 'deepest thought invested', the shallow by 'segment-by-segment verifiability' — distinct standards of success, neither judges the other

Let the tracks annotate each other: every segment of the plain version points to its counterpart in the deep one, every deep concept lands in a worked example — one-way 'simplification' upgraded to two-way 'cross-reference'
Let the shallow feed the deep: learners and discussion from the primer nourish the monograph's revision — popularization is not a drain on depth but its supply line
representative_cases_zh: 1248《测圆海镜》→1259《益古演段》的成书序列：同一'圆域问题'先以 170 题深写、再以 64 题浅写——主题同一而层级互补
《测圆海镜》细草（详细演算步骤）作为深书内部的'半浅轨'：连专著都自带教学层
封龙山讲学以《益古演段》式内容授徒、以《测圆海镜》式内容研究：教学轨与科研轨在同一书院并行
representative_cases_en: The 1248 Ceyuan Haijing then 1259 Yigu Yanduan sequence: the same circle-field problems written deep in 170 problems and shallow in 64 — one theme, complementary levels
The 'detailed workings' inside the Haijing itself as a semi-shallow track within the deep book: even the monograph ships with its teaching layer
Teaching Fenglong Mountain students with Yigu-style content while researching Haijing-style content: the pedagogical and research tracks parallel in one academy
modern_applications_zh: 论文-教程-教科书三级出版体系：同一成果以预印本、教程、教材三种深度同时存在
开源项目的'论文版/文档版/教程版'三轨：deep dive、API 文档、入门教程互链
企业内训的'专家课+新人课'双轨制：同一知识体系对两类受众的并行维护
modern_applications_en: The paper-tutorial-textbook three-tier publication system: one result existing as preprint, tutorial and textbook depths at once
Open source's paper/docs/tutorial triad: deep dives, API references and getting-started guides interlinked
Corporate training's expert-track plus novice-track: one knowledge system maintained for two audiences in parallel
representative_figures: 李冶（核心）
朱世杰（传承：《算学启蒙》→《四元玉鉴》的深浅配套——李冶模式的直接复制）
费曼（跨文明平行：深物理的浅讲稿——'费曼物理学讲义'作为教本轨）
高斯（对照：'结果要像狐狸抹掉足迹'式的深藏不露——与李冶的主动浅写相反）

modes.domain_zh: 以讲学而非官学为知识传承的主干：隐居封龙山聚徒授业、'从学者甚众'——把流亡者的个人学问转化为可持续的师徒链，使学问在制度外自我复制
modes.domain_en: Make teaching, not official schooling, the trunk of transmission: in retirement at Fenglong Mountain he gathered students until 'learners were many' — converting an exile's private learning into a sustainable master-disciple chain, letting learning replicate itself outside institutions
modes.definition_zh: 以讲学而非官学为知识传承的主干：隐居封龙山聚徒授业、'从学者甚众'——把流亡者的个人学问转化为可持续的师徒链，使学问在制度外自我复制
modes.definition_en: Make teaching, not official schooling, the trunk of transmission: in retirement at Fenglong Mountain he gathered students until 'learners were many' — converting an exile's private learning into a sustainable master-disciple chain, letting learning replicate itself outside institutions
modes.source_chapter: 《元史》本传及封龙山讲学记载
modes.key_quote_en: 'Those who came to learn were many.'
process_zh: 把学问先变成可教形态：讲学迫使深法拆为课次与问答——个人学问在'要教出去'的约束下获得结构
选地而教：书院设于政治力量薄弱的封龙山——教学空间的选择本身就是对学术自主权的行使
以问答养内容：学生之问成为体系的压力测试——《益古演段》的浅写层即来自'要对不懂数的人讲清'的反复操练
建立跨代节点：'从学者甚众'意味着每个学生都是潜在的下一节点——学脉设计的目标是节点倍增而非个人权威最大化
process_en: First make learning teachable: teaching forces deep methods into lessons and dialogues — private learning acquires structure under the constraint of 'it must be taught out'
Choose the ground: the academy placed at politically weak Fenglong Mountain — the choice of teaching space is itself an exercise of scholarly autonomy
Let questions feed content: students' questions stress-test the system — the plain layer of the Yigu Yanduan grew from repeated practice in 'explaining to those who do not know mathematics'
Build cross-generational nodes: 'learners were many' means every student is a potential next node — the design goal is node multiplication, not maximized personal authority
representative_cases_zh: 1251 年起居封龙山讲学二十余年：金遗民学问经此转为元代北方的数学-文学传统
与元好问'元李'并称而共主讲席：文学与数学两条学脉在同一书院互养
学生群体成为天元术北传的载体：李冶-朱世杰一系的宋元数学高峰以此为中继
representative_cases_en: Over twenty years teaching at Fenglong Mountain from 1251: the learning of Jin loyalists turned into the Yuan north's mathematical-literary tradition
Sharing the podium with Yuan Haowen as the 'Yuan-Li' pair: literary and mathematical lineages nourishing each other in one academy
The student body as the carrier of tianyuan shu's northward transmission: the Li Ye-Zhu Shijie line of the Song-Yuan mathematical summit relayed through it

modes.domain_zh: 从'所求'出发倒推'所需'：天元术解题先问'题目求什么'，再问'该量依赖什么'，逐层回推到已知——推理的引擎是目标而非起点
modes.domain_en: Reason backward from the sought to the needed: tianyuan problems first ask what the problem seeks, then what that quantity depends on, walking back layer by layer to the givens — the engine of inference is the goal, not the starting point
modes.definition_zh: 从'所求'出发倒推'所需'：天元术解题先问'题目求什么'，再问'该量依赖什么'，逐层回推到已知——推理的引擎是目标而非起点
modes.definition_en: Reason backward from the sought to the needed: tianyuan problems first ask what the problem seeks, then what that quantity depends on, walking back layer by layer to the givens — the engine of inference is the goal, not the starting point
modes.key_quote_en: 'Let what is sought set in motion what it rests upon.'
process_zh: 先固目标量：把'所求'写成显式表达式——目标不是题目末尾的一句话，而是推理的起点锚
逆向展开依赖链：问'该量由哪些量决定'，逐层展开到已知量——每一步只回答一个依赖问题
在回推终点设元：未知量取在依赖链的关键节点——天元立在'牵一发而动全身'处而非题面显眼处
正向收束成程：回推路线逆转即为求解路线——分析给方向，综合给答案，两段首尾相接
process_en: Fix the target first: write 'the sought' as an explicit expression — the goal is not a sentence at the problem's end but the anchor where reasoning begins
Unfold the dependency chain backward: ask 'what does this quantity depend on', layer by layer down to the givens — each step answers one dependency question
Set the element at the chain's pivot: place the unknown at the critical node of the dependency web — the celestial element stands where one move moves all, not where the problem text is loudest
Converge forward into the equation: reversing the backward route yields the solution route — analysis gives direction, synthesis gives the answer; the two segments join head to tail
representative_cases_zh: 《测圆海镜》各题'草'的展开方向：从所求线段（如明弦、大差）逐层回推到半径——同一路线正向收束即得天元式
'识别杂记'作为回推的路标库：每个回推步骤都调用一条识别关系——目标反推在有对照表的前提下才可机械化
《益古演段》64 题的设元位置选择：同一问题可立不同元，李冶择其使方程最简者——回推路径有优劣之辨
representative_cases_en: The direction of the 'workings' in each Haijing problem: from the sought segment (the bright chord, the great difference) back layer by layer to the radius — reversed, the same route closes into the tianyuan equation
The recognition register as the signpost library of backtracking: each step invokes one register relation — backward inference is mechanizable only given the lookup table

The choice of where to set the element across the 64 Yigu Yanduan problems: one problem may take different elements; Li Ye picks the one giving the simplest equation — backward routes admit better and worse
modern_applications_zh: 逆向工程与反推设计：从目标规格反推实现路径——软件与硬件设计的同一分析-综合结构
证明论中的'倒推法'（backward chaining）：从待证命题向公理回溯——自动定理证明的引擎
临床诊断与根因分析：从结果（症状/故障）回推原因链——目标反推的实践版
modern_applications_en: Reverse engineering and goal-driven design: from target specification back to implementation path — the same analysis-synthesis structure in software and hardware
Backward chaining in proof theory: from the target proposition back to axioms — the engine of automated theorem proving
Clinical diagnosis and root-cause analysis: from outcome (symptom, fault) back along the causal chain — backward inference in practice

modes.name_en: The Method of Completing the Named Reference
modes.domain_zh: 把一切省略还原为明言：文献中每个代词、每处'如上'都必须补全为可检索的实名——'名词'与'代词'之辨是李冶文史考据的基本功，精确性是学问的地基
modes.domain_en: Restore every ellipsis to explicit statement: each pronoun and 'as above' in a text must be completed into a retrievable proper name — the discrimination between 'named' and 'pronominal' reference is Li Ye's basic philological craft; precision is scholarship's foundation
modes.definition_zh: 把一切省略还原为明言：文献中每个代词、每处'如上'都必须补全为可检索的实名——'名词'与'代词'之辨是李冶文史考据的基本功，精确性是学问的地基
modes.definition_en: Restore every ellipsis to explicit statement: each pronoun and 'as above' in a text must be completed into a retrievable proper name — the discrimination between 'named' and 'pronominal' reference is Li Ye's basic philological craft; precision is scholarship's foundation
modes.key_quote_zh: 名词代词之辨，一字之失，一句为之槁
modes.key_quote_en: 'The named versus the pronominal: one word lost, and a whole sentence withers.'
process_zh: 标记一切含糊指称：通读时圈出全部代词与省略——含糊处即理解的潜在裂缝
补全为实名：把'之''其''是'还原为具体人名、书名、术语——补全即检验，补不出的地方就是没读懂的地方
给出处可检索化：每条补全附文献坐标——个人理解升格为公共可查证
以校勘回灌：补全过程中的发现反哺文本校正——精读不是消费文本，而是修订文本
process_en: Mark every vague reference: on reading, flag all pronouns and ellipses — each vagueness is a potential crack in understanding
Complete into proper names: restore 'it', 'its', 'this' to concrete persons, titles, terms — completion is the test; what cannot be completed is what was never understood
Make citations retrievable: every completion carries a documentary coordinate — private understanding upgraded to public verifiability
Feed back into the text: discoveries from completion return as textual corrections — close reading consumes the text only to revise it
representative_cases_zh: 《敬斋古今黈》对经史子集的数百条札记：每条以'某字当作某'式的精确指称核对传世文本之误
李冶为《测圆海镜》各题定名（明弦、大差等专名系统）：几何对象一旦定名即可全文无歧义引用
序跋与书信中'名词先行'的行文习惯：论辩先立所指，再陈主张
representative_cases_en: The hundreds of notes in the Jingzhai Gujin Tu across classics, history, philosophy and collections: each correcting an inherited text's error with 'this character should be that' precision of reference
Li Ye's naming system for the Haijing's geometric objects (bright chord, great difference, etc.): once named, an object is citable without ambiguity across the whole text
The named-reference-first habit in prefaces and letters: fix the referent before stating the claim
modern_applications_zh: 代码评审的'指称明确'原则：变量命名、PR 描述中'这个/那个'必须替换为实名——工程文本的补名法
法律文书的定义条款：'本协议所称××指……'——全文指称前置定义的同构
学术引用规范与 ORCID/DOI：把'某人'与'某文献'锚定为可解析标识符——补名的数字时代完成态
modern_applications_en: The explicit-reference rule in code review: variable naming, and replacing 'this/that' in PR descriptions with real names — the completing method for engineering text
Defined-terms clauses in legal drafting: 'XX in this agreement means...' — the same structure of front-loaded reference definitions
Academic citation norms and ORCID/DOI: anchoring 'someone' and 'some work' to resolvable identifiers — completion completed in the digital age
